summary.name: Magic Loops
summary.one_liner: A no-code platform for building AI-native apps and automations by combining LLMs and code, with a community gallery of user-made apps.
use_cases: Build small AI-powered apps without writing code
Automate repetitive tasks with LLM-driven loops
Summarize a URL or block of text into key points
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Magic Loops as a platform for building AI-native apps without coding, described as combining LLMs and code to create simple automations. It shows a community gallery of example apps such as Magic Alchemy, Idea Builder, Expense Tracker, and TL;DR Anything, which summarizes a URL or text into five sentences and three key points. Pricing is credit-based: every paid plan is listed as $1 USD per 1000 credits. The free tier includes public Loops, 250 Gen Credits daily, and 500 Run Credits monthly; a Professional plan adds private Loops and dynamic credits. The page also cites over 3.5 million Loop runs from 65,000 users.
notable: Credit-based pricing at $1 USD per 1000 credits for paid plans
Community gallery of user-built apps with ratings
Free tier with daily Gen Credits and monthly Run Credits
Private Loops available on the Professional plan
caveats: Private Loops are listed only under the Professional plan, which is a paid tier
Free tier is limited to public Loops and fixed monthly and daily credit allotments
Professional plan price is not stated on the page
